name: Essbaum
beschreibung:
Enjoying a wonderful secluded setting with sweeping views of the Kaiser mountains, Essbaumhof in Koessen welcomes guests with genuine alpine warmth. Families and couples love the comfortable holiday apartments and authentic farm life.

Children enjoy ample space to play and interact with animals, while hiking paths, Lake Walchsee, and cross-country ski trails are nearby.
kurzbeschreibung: Farmstead Essbaum in Koessen offers an authentic family farm holiday experience in the picturesque Kaiserwinkl.
